name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India (via National Scholarship Portal)
amount_note: Rs 12,000 per annum for 3 years at UG level
_eligibility_note: min_marks_pct is null. Eligibility requires top 20 percentile in Class 12 board; this is a rank-based rule, not a raw percentage.
deadline_year_note: Annual cycle; check scholarships.gov.in for current year deadline

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
amount_note: Rs 50,000 per annum for up to 4 years; girls only
deadline_year_note: Annual cycle; check scholarships.gov.in for current year deadline

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students (Degree)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
amount_note: Rs 50,000 per annum for up to 4 years; minimum 40% disability certificate required
deadline_year_note: Annual cycle; check scholarships.gov.in for current year deadline

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India
amount_note: Rs 60,000 per annum (Rs 5,000/month) plus Rs 20,000 annual mentorship grant
_eligibility_note: min_marks_pct is null. Eligibility is rank-based (top 1% of board or JEE/NEET rank within top 10,000), not a raw percentage.
deadline_year_note: Annual cycle; check online-inspire.gov.in. No income cap; merit-based: top 1% in Class 12 State/Central Board or JEE/NEET rank within top 10,000

name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
amount_note: Rs 12,000 per annum (Rs 1,000/month via DBT); girl students who studied in TN Govt schools Class 6 to 12 only
deadline_year_note: Ongoing scheme; check penkalvi.tn.gov.in for current cycle
